content.title: SABR Q3 Deep Dive: Revenue Outpaces Expectations While Guidance and Margins Face Pressure
content.summary: Travel technology company Sabre (NASDAQ:SABR) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.5% year on year to $715.2 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $644.9 million was less impressive, coming in 3.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.01 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
